identity_evidence_sources.identity_observation: GlobalId 1faflkXXH6M9cnYPE9Liir is an untyped IfcBuildingElementProxy named Electric flue check valve. The review prohibits inference of served appliance, duct connection, powered action or access from proximity or shape.
The object has geometry but no type or installation-anchor semantics; identity, mounting face, access direction and the purpose of its two openings remain pending.
The high kitchen proxy has no IFC type, system or ports and is not eligible for automatic conversion to a damper or other distribution element.

project_projection_sources.observation: PX009 is a location/envelope marker, not a model plan projection and therefore is not used as drawing geometry.

rejected_near_candidates.reason: The official page identifies a 150 mm, 230 V electric valve, but the project IFC contains no Novy attribution or article number and the proxy geometry is not sufficient to prove identity.
The patent describes a spherical electric flue check-valve type and is shape-context evidence only; it does not identify the project product or provide manufacturer CAD for it.

official_product_cad.reason: Manufacturer and model are absent from the project IFC and could not be resolved mechanically. No unrelated manufacturer CAD, patent drawing or third-party CAD is substituted.
